papers.title: Effects of Heat Treatment and Oxidation on the Microstructure and Compressive Strength of Ti-6Al-4V Lattice Structures Prepared by SLM
papers.abstract: The property of titanium alloys can be promoted via heat processing by changing their micro structure. Nevertheless, Ti-6Al-4V lattice frameworks require a personalized method on account of their big specific surface area and the stress gathering at the lattice joint points. In this research work, we have carried out a comparison between air and vacuum heat processing for Ti-6Al-4V lattices which are made through selective laser melting (SLM). The influences of these handling methods on the micro structure and compression performance were researched. When we carry out the air heat treatment operation, there was one oxide layer that got formed. This layer has the significant effect of decreasing the compressive strength of the Ti-6Al-4V lattices. In addition, the hardened α-Ti which is under the oxide layer caused a change from ductile fracture to brittle fracture and reduced the energy-absorption capacity. From another aspect, the vacuum heat treating has mitigated the damage which is related to oxidation. It also gave help to the formation of a lamellar inner micro structure, which thus contributed to stable deformation and a promoted energy-absorption capability. According to these results, it can be seen that vacuum heat handling is a more suitable approach for improving the micro structure and compression property of SLM-manufactured Ti-6Al-4V lattice frameworks.

llm.relevance_to_user: 本文直接研究了两种热处理方法（空气和真空）对SLM制造Ti-6Al-4V点阵结构的显微组织和抗压性能的影响，符合后处理研究方向。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on compressive strength rather than fatigue, and does not include fatigue testing or other mechanical properties like tensile or fatigue life.

summary_zh.motivation: 比较空气和真空热处理对SLM钛合金点阵结构性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对SLM制备的Ti-6Al-4V点阵进行空气和真空热处理，对比显微组织和压缩性能。
summary_zh.result: 空气热处理形成氧化层降低强度，真空热处理形成层状组织提高能量吸收。
summary_zh.validation: 通过压缩实验和微观结构观察验证热处理效果。

summary_en.motivation: To compare the effects of air and vacuum heat treatments on the microstructure and compressive properties of SLM-produced Ti-6Al-4V lattice structures.
summary_en.method: Ti-6Al-4V lattice samples were fabricated by SLM and subjected to heat treatment in air or vacuum, followed by microstructural analysis and compression tests.
summary_en.result: Air heat treatment formed an oxide layer that reduced compressive strength and changed fracture mode to brittle, while vacuum heat treatment promoted a lamellar structure and improved energy absorption.
summary_en.validation: Compression testing and SEM/OM microstructural observation were used to validate the effects of the two heat treatment conditions.

papers.title: Integrated in-situ experimental and crystal plasticity finite element investigation on grain-scale localized damage and fatigue prediction of forged Ti-6Al-4V alloy

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究的是锻造Ti-6Al-4V合金，而非增材制造材料，与用户关注的增材制造Ti-6Al-4V机械性能方向不符。
llm.why_not_core: The paper investigates forged Ti-6Al-4V, not additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V, which is the core requirement of Layer 1.

summary_zh.motivation: 揭示锻造Ti-6Al-4V合金在晶粒尺度的局部损伤和疲劳预测机制
summary_zh.method: 结合原位实验与晶体塑性有限元模拟进行晶粒尺度分析
summary_zh.result: 实现了对锻造Ti-6Al-4V合金疲劳寿命的准确预测
summary_zh.validation: 通过原位实验数据验证了晶体塑性模型的预测精度

summary_en.motivation: To understand grain-scale localized damage and fatigue behavior in forged Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
summary_en.method: Integrated in-situ experimental characterization with crystal plasticity finite element simulations.
summary_en.result: Accurate fatigue life prediction for forged Ti-6Al-4V was achieved.
summary_en.validation: Validated by in-situ experimental data from mechanical testing and grain-scale observations.
